requirement.normalizedRequirement: The Polar Ship Certificate validity dates, survey dates, and endorsements shall match the applicable SOLAS certificate schedule, and polar_certificate_supplement_present shall be true with required equipment records.

requirement.sourceText: Polar Ship Certificate validity, survey dates and endorsements shall be harmonized with the relevant SOLAS certificates in accordance with the provisions of SOLAS regulation I/14. The certificate shall include a supplement, recording equipment required by the Code.
